summary: A chord instrument and songwriting groovebox: pick a chord progression, add drums, bass and arpeggios, and play over it with root keys plus chord-type modifier keys.
features: 130 progression ideas, up to 16 editable chord slots
"Auto Harmony" builds chords from the chosen key and scale
Drum kits with fills and drops; 13 arpeggiator modes; 13 FX presets
"Chord Lab" shows notes and intervals and suggests next chords
Six saved song ideas and the last three recorded takes
USB audio with chord and bass stems; MIDI out and clock in or out

headings: play chords and learn the keys
the keyboard guide and root lights
